import sympy as S
q=S.Rational; I=S.I
X=S.diag(-1,0,1);Y=S.Matrix([[0,1,-q(6,5)*I],[1,0,1],[q(6,5)*I,1,0]])
W=[S.eye(3),X,Y,X**2,Y**2,X*Y+Y*X,I*(X*Y-Y*X),X*Y*X,Y*X*Y]
# hermitian vector 9 real coords diag plus Re/Im upper
def v(M):
 return S.Matrix([M[0,0],M[1,1],M[2,2],S.re(M[0,1]),S.im(M[0,1]),S.re(M[0,2]),S.im(M[0,2]),S.re(M[1,2]),S.im(M[1,2])])
B=S.Matrix.hstack(*[v(w) for w in W])
print("det",S.factor(B.det()))
print("rank",B.rank())
print("commutant rank")
# solve [Z,X]=[Z,Y]=0 generic complex maybe use 9 hermitian coords
a=S.symbols('a0:9', real=True);Z=sum((a[k]*W[k] for k in range(9)),S.zeros(3))
eq=list(Z*X-X*Z)+list(Z*Y-Y*Z)
M,b=S.linear_eq_to_matrix(eq,a)
print(M.rank(),9-M.rank())
